IF YOU WANT TO WRITE CLEAN PYTHON FOR INTERVIEWS, STOP REPEATING BOILERPLATE IN EVERY FUNCTION.

MEMORIZE THESE 3 DECORATOR PATTERNS: 1/5

The `@lru_cache` decorator turns exponential recursion into linear DP.

Add `@lru_cache(maxsize=None)` above your recursive function. Fibonacci, grid paths, coin change — all go from O(2^n) to O(n) with one line. 2/5

`@dataclass` replaces 20 lines of `__init__`, `__repr__`, `__eq__` boilerplate.

Use `@dataclass(frozen=True)` for immutable LeetCode nodes (TreeNode, ListNode). Cleaner code, fewer bugs, faster to type under time pressure. 3/5

`@contextmanager` from `contextlib` lets you write setup/teardown as a generator.

Wrap DB connections, file handles, or mock patches in `with` blocks. Keeps test code flat and resources deterministic — interviewers notice. 4/5

I post daily breakdowns like this for backend, SQL, and interviews.

Follow @owlsky17 so you don't miss the next one. 5/5
